plan.title: Award Vendor B and Approve Proposal

steps.note: Open the prepared closed two-bid event directly on Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project setting for the tenant.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate the prepared line's full quantity to Vendor B, the second bid.
Verify the available line is fully allocated to one vendor and reflects 10 × 90 = 900.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Fill mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Verify the submitted proposal is awaiting approval.

args.need: sign in as the approver, open the submitted proposal from Approvals, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve it

steps.note: The catalog cannot perform the separate approver login and approval.
Create the purchase order after approval, when the approver action has completed.
Verify the available awarded line appears once in the purchase order with quantity 10.
Verify the event remains in the closed/history state after the available award flow.
